text: Assumption: Active diagnostic or authentication operations shall be completed prior to the destructor call — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Active diagnostic or authentication operations shall be completed prior to the destructor call — is this correct?
norm: active diagnostic or authentication operations shall be completed prior to the destructor call
assumption: Active diagnostic or authentication operations shall be completed prior to the destructor call.
rationale: The specification classifies the destructor as not thread-safe and describes no implicit cancellation of running operations.
